original_test_intent: Stress all approved OBlex targets with 50 random-pattern iterations using up to 98% memory and 7658 blocks, stop at the first miscompare and verify no memory or platform issue.
original_method: Set the exact controlled environment, run one bounded Firexs OBlex command in an isolated maintenance window, retain per-iteration/block/debug evidence and correlate miscompare, OOM, ECC/MCE, thermal, power and driver health.
manual_activity: Operator supervises memory pressure and OOB recovery; engineer approves the 98% allocation and resolves any miscompare/system anomaly before deciding the DUT verdict.
required_inputs: Exact target memory/device scope and OS-reserved memory policy
Maintenance, workload isolation, OOM/thermal/power abort and OOB recovery
safety_requirements: Confirm OS and recovery memory remain available before 98% allocation
Drain all production workloads and establish OOB access
Continuously monitor free memory, swap/OOM, ECC/MCE, GPU and platform health
Stop immediately on miscompare, pressure, hang, log, cooling, thermal or power fault
Preserve complete debug/output evidence and verify normal memory/idle recovery
agent_execution_scope: Export the three exact variables in an isolated process environment
Run exactly one approved literal Firexs command
Capture all iterations/blocks/miscompares, exit and system telemetry
Do not alter parameters, suppress failures, rerun automatically or decide PASS/FAIL
engineer_actions: Review full evidence and decide PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The generic instruction omits the only reproducible workload definition and cannot enforce first-miscompare or memory-safety behavior.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Run the exact source `firexs oblex` command once after exporting the three approved variables and enabling full OOM/ECC/MCE/thermal/power monitoring.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All environment variables, 50 iterations, 98%, 7658 blocks, random/all and exit-on-miscompare plus source 5/30 timing are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bind the command/environment hash to an iteration ledger, memory-pressure timeline, first-miscompare status and post-run recovery proof.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds explicit OS-survival controls and complete evidence without reducing the near-capacity workload.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Package installation and workload execution remain separate checkpoints.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Experimental mode and 98% allocation may behave differently by tool/platform version; approval must be version-specific.

project_override_considerations: Project authority may lower memory percentage only through an explicit coverage-impact decision; it may not silently omit experimental mode, iteration count or first-miscompare stop.
expected_evidence: Tool versions, target scope and exact environment/command
Critical approval, memory-reservation and isolation evidence

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, environment and literal command consistently define one OBlex memory-stress case; duplicated step numbering does not create a second intended run.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Tool, isolation and safety inputs can be supplied; static review is complete.

review_improvement: Restores the exact high-memory workload and converts a generic summary into first-miscompare, per-iteration and OS-survival evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: Allocating 98% without reserving memory for the kernel, logging and remote control can make a healthy memory subsystem appear failed through OOM or loss of access. Conversely, a zero exit without the debug/iteration record can conceal skipped blocks. The oracle must combine exact workload progress, no miscompare and maintained OS/platform health through recovery.
